desc: With its custom touches, SpeedSafe assisted opening, and versatile clip-point blade, the Camshaft is designed to get your engine going. The clip-point blade offers good piercing capabilities, while its slight belly curve provides excellent slicing. The contoured handle is textured for a solid grip. Custom touches include the unique pivot design and decorative backspacer. SpeedSafe assisted opening makes it quick and easy to open one-handed. The Camshaft’s pocketclip is designed for deep carry and is left/right reversible.
